obernants.assumptions: No external models, gparse annotate, real corpora, teacher, training, lesson workflows or GPU executed. Existing learn-based tests were inspected but not selected. Model::load handles synthetic in-memory TSV only. Filesystem/parser effects modeled by inspection. Source production prefixes remain byte-identical to base; added tests only.
obernants.domain: Bounded synthetic UTF-8/CoNLL strings, manually supplied tiny model TSVs/states and parsed score comments. Valid indices; nonempty callback outputs; k>=1 for nonpunctuation; every alternative has a base. Finite gain arithmetic and u32/usize/i64 representability. Explicit panic/error witnesses explore selected invalid boundaries without production repair.
obernants.observation_scope: Real joins: text::norm/units -> seg key and Piece semantics; conllu Token/Word -> gold and segmenter evaluation; lib::cut_with passed as callback by main lattice_cmd/choose_cmd; lib::segment_line calls split_in and cut_as; main score uses conllu heads and text normalization. Tagged independent paths: main split/prepare/Part partitioning, main score diagnostics, model TSV codec and annotate filesystem/subprocess adapter. Independent per-token lattice choices do not imply jointly optimal tree; positional merge count equality is not parser identity verification.
obernants.operator: On admitted valid cuts consonant-checked results cannot alter unpointed written letters after removing H; finite nonpositive gains cannot leave lattice base; merge cannot copy FORM/MISC from parser. Empty-form fallback Cut(0) is explicitly outside the spelling guarantee.
